name: appletv
title: Apple TV
description: A remote for your Apple TV under the keys: the clickpad on the arrows, Now Playing in full with chapters, subtitles, Up Next and lyrics, links played on the TV in one key (copy a YouTube link and pal offers it), your apps a digit away, typing into the TV's search from the keyboard, sleep and wake, users, and the menu bar. Pairs in a guided setup, no other app or hub needed.
author: pal

settings.label: Apple TV
settings.description: Which paired Apple TV the remote, the root commands and the bar item control, by its name. Empty: the one paired last. d on the remote switches, and writes it here.

settings.label: Dock
settings.placeholder: An app's name (YouTube) or bundle id
settings.description: The apps on the remote's dock, in order; each gets a digit, 1 to 8. Empty: the apps you open most. cmd+D in Apple TV Apps adds or removes one.

settings.label: Skip
settings.description: How far , and . (and Skip Back / Forward at the root) move what plays.

settings.label: Wake
settings.text: Wake the Apple TV when the remote opens
settings.description: With HDMI-CEC on, the TV set comes on with it.

settings.label: Stay connected
settings.text: Keep the connection open in the background
settings.description: So the menu bar item follows what plays and a key answers at once. Off, pal connects while the remote is open and lets go a minute and a half after.

remote.title: Apple TV Remote
remote.description: The clickpad on the arrows, Enter selects, Backspace goes back, the TV button on h; what is playing with its cover and a seek bar, the volume, your dock of apps on the digits, and a field that types into the TV.

keys.title: Play the link just copied (or pick one)
Type into the field the TV shows

now.title: Now Playing on Apple TV
now.description: What plays on the Apple TV in full: the cover with its colour behind it, the show, season and episode or the artist, the synopsis, a position bar split at the chapters, hold-to-scrub, speed, subtitles and audio, and a panel for Up Next, Chapters, Audio, Subtitles, Lyrics and Info.

keys.title: Scrub: hold to go faster, one seek when you let go
Next panel: Up Next, Chapters, Audio, Subtitles, Lyrics, Info

keys.keys: q c a s y i
keys.title: Open a panel
Walk the panel; play, jump or choose

play.title: Play on Apple TV
play.description: Send a link to the TV in one key: a YouTube video (at its start time), a Netflix title or an Apple TV+ page. Lists the link just copied, the browser tab in front, every link in the clipboard history and what was played before; a link typed or pasted at the root is offered there too.

keys.title: Play from the start (a link with a start time)

apps.title: Apple TV Apps
apps.description: Every app on the Apple TV with its icon; Enter opens it on the TV.

keys.title: Add to or remove from the dock

commands.title: Apple TV
commands.description: Play or pause, sleep, wake, home, Control Center, the screen saver, skip, volume, typing and switching users or Apple TVs, as root results.

keys.title: On Type on Apple TV: the text to type

users.title: Apple TV Users
users.description: The people signed in on the Apple TV; Enter switches to one.

setup.title: Set Up Apple TV
setup.description: Finds the Apple TVs on the network and pairs one in two codes: the remote, then what is playing (skippable); ends with a check of what works.

playing.title: Apple TV
playing.description: What plays on the Apple TV, hidden while nothing does; a link just copied brings it up for a minute and a half to offer it. The popover is the remote: what plays, the clickpad and the buttons, the dock on the digits, the copied link on l.

store.tagline: Your Apple TV's remote, Now Playing and links, from the keyboard
features: The clickpad on the arrows, Enter selects, Backspace goes back, h is the TV button; swipes on shift and the arrows
Now Playing in full: the cover's colour behind it, chapters on the position bar, hold-to-scrub, speed, subtitles and audio, Up Next, lyrics
Play a link on the TV in one key: copy a YouTube link and pal offers it, or paste one at the root
Your dock of apps on the digits, drawn as the TV's own tvOS icons; every app at the root: type `youtube`, press Enter
Type into the TV's search from the keyboard instead of hunting letters on screen
Sleep and wake, Control Center, the app switcher, the screen saver, switching users
A menu bar item with what plays; its popover is the remote
Guided setup: finds the Apple TV, takes the code it shows, and checks what works
In a group with your TV (Settings › Groups), the remote sets the TV's volume, switches its inputs and wakes both
